notes: Interns are City employees. Interns need a work permit, Social Security Number, background check and ID. The job site says to consider unpaid internships too. Funded by the state Youth Service Corps.
name: Employ & Empower City Internships
what_you_do: Work as an intern in a City of San Diego department. Current postings include Stormwater, Engineering and Police roles. You get an orientation at the start. You also get mentoring.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 30 who are enrolled in a school or training program (show proof). Priority goes to people from communities of concern. You must have the legal right to work in the U.S.
pay_detail: $19.47 to $22.75 per hour, set by education level
duration: Varies by posting. Hiring takes about 6 to 8 weeks.
deadline_text: Internships are posted one at a time. On Oct 9, 2026, six internship postings were listed with closing dates from Oct 14 to Oct 30, 2026.
how_to_apply: Pick a posting on the City internship job site. Attach proof that you are enrolled in a school or training program. Then apply. The city strongly urges you to add a resume and cover letter. The job site says to consider unpaid internships too.
